concept: ELB: NLB for static IP and L4 with ultra-low latency
tests: Choosing a load balancer type for static IP, TCP, and millions of connections per second.
expected: Network Load Balancer — Layer 4, millions of req/s, ultra-low latency, static IP / Elastic IP per AZ. Triggers: "static IP", "TCP/UDP", "millions of connections per second", "ultra-low latency".
why_not: ALB is Layer 7 without a static IP; Gateway Load Balancer inserts third-party appliances; Classic LB is legacy.
